title: Woman Arrested, Dragged Away After Quietly Speaking About Flock at City Council Meeting
excerpt: Citizens of Springfield, Missouri showed up to a city council meeting to discuss the city’s Flock contract. The mayor shut them down and arrested two people for ‘disruption of meetings of city council.’
